_comment: Copy this to seed/beta-identity.json and edit it. That filename is gitignored.
There is deliberately NO password field here, and the seeder REFUSES a file that
has one. The password comes from BETA_SEED_PASSWORD or a hidden prompt, so it is
never written to disk, never committed and never printed.
role: "member" builds an ordinary account, which is what tests the real product.
Use "admin" only when you specifically need the staff dashboard from this login --
an admin sees moderation queues, revenue and every member's detail, so the app it
shows you is not the app a member sees.
